detail.longDescription: I am using PyTorch's torchvision.models.detection.fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn_v2 to train an object detection model. By default, when I call the model in training mode, it returns a dictionary containing the losses. When I switch to evaluation mode, it returns a list of predictions containing boxes, labels and scores. For example in train() mode, the model will return loss_classifier, loss_box_reg, loss_objectness and loss_rpn_box_reg. In eval() mode, the model will return boxes, labels and scores. However, I would like to access both the losses and the detection predictions during training and validation, preferably from the same forward pass. This would allow me to analyze the model's predictions and monitor detection metrics. So i want to ask if there is a way to get both losses and detection predictions from the model no matter what mode it is in.
